skills.name: alphacharts-core
skills.title: Core
skills.description: Decide how to answer a chart request: a built-in study, a computed series, or a refusal; overlay or own pane; what the script language cannot do.
load_when: Any request to draw, add or change an indicator on one chart.
Deciding between a built-in study, a computed series and a refusal.
Choosing overlay or an own pane, or explaining what the language cannot do.

skills.name: alphacharts-script-language
skills.title: Script language
skills.description: The whole script language: types and qualifiers, no coercion, series and history, na, state and var, loops, inputs, the grammar, limits and what is refused. Load before writing any script that is more than one study call.
load_when: Writing a computed series, anything with var, loops, x[n] history or na handling.
A diagnostic mentions types, state or history.
Looking up a math function, a kernel (ta.sma, ta.stdev, ta.highest) or a builtin series.

skills.name: alphacharts-studies
skills.title: Studies
skills.description: How to call any built-in study as ta.<id>: the index by purpose, the calling rules, and per-family references with every parameter, default, range, option and output. Load before writing a ta.<id> call.
load_when: The request names a standard indicator (RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ADX, VWAP, Supertrend, a candlestick pattern).
Writing any ta.<id> call and needing its exact parameters or outputs.
Checking whether a study exists.

skills.name: alphacharts-plots-and-panes
skills.title: Plots and panes
skills.description: Drawing a script's output: plot, plot styles, hline, fill, plotshape, overlay versus own pane, colours as constants, input.* controls, and a line shown only where a condition holds with two gapped plots.
load_when: The request is about how something looks: line style, histogram, shaded band, markers, levels, colours.
Adding user-adjustable settings (input.*).
Showing a line only where a condition holds.

skills.name: alphacharts-colour-and-shading
skills.title: Colour and shading
skills.description: Colour that depends on the bar: barcolor to colour candles, bgcolor to shade the background of a pane, a line coloured by a condition, and indicator(scale="left") to draw a series of another magnitude on the left axis.
load_when: The request is to colour candles or bars where a condition holds.
Shading the price chart or an indicator pane where a condition holds.
Colouring a line by a condition, or drawing a series on the left axis.

skills.name: alphacharts-outside-series
skills.title: Outside series
skills.description: Reading another instrument or another timeframe from a script with outside(symbol, field, timeframe): ratios, spreads, relative strength, beta, correlation, residuals, a Kalman filter on two series, multi-timeframe indicators, previous-day levels, and the exact rules that decide which of its bars a chart bar sees.
load_when: The request involves a second instrument: against the index, spread, ratio, relative strength, beta, correlation, the sector.
The request names another timeframe: RSI on the hourly, daily levels on an intraday chart, daily returns.
Previous day's high, low or close.

skills.name: alphacharts-quant-recipes
skills.title: Quant recipes
skills.description: Worked, numerically verified scripts for quant measures: z-score of returns, realised volatility, HV ratio, rolling Sharpe, beta and correlation on a series' own lag, autocorrelation, ADX/EMA regime, distance in ATR units, range expansion, breakout share, cumulative volume delta, session VWAP and the previous session's VWAP, swing highs and lows, VWAP anchored at a swing low, opening range, a Kalman-style filter.
load_when: The request is a statistic or state machine on one instrument's bars rather than a named indicator.
Volatility, Sharpe, z-score, autocorrelation, regime, filter or volume-delta requests.
Adapting a verified formula instead of deriving one.

skills.name: alphacharts-troubleshooting
skills.title: Troubleshooting
skills.description: Every diagnostic the compiler and the runtime can emit, with its cause and fix; the common ones here, the rest by phase in the catalogue files.
load_when: A compile or run diagnostic came back for a script.
A script compiles but shows nothing, all gaps, or the wrong scale.
